title: daboecia cantabrica f. eburnea
intro: Daboecia cantabrica f. eburnea, commonly known as the white mountain-heath, is a flowering plant species in the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to aid in the relief of various health issues, including its potential to help soothe and calm the mind and body, reducing stress and anxiety. Its therapeutic actions include its ability to exhibit sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Daboecia cantabrica f. eburnea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
